# Website Migration Readiness Audit

## Purpose
Prepare a migration-readiness report before a client moves a website between platforms, domains, or architectures.

## Workflow
1. Confirm client authorization and define source and target scope.
2. Inventory important URLs, templates, content types, media, forms, and integrations from public or client-approved evidence.
3. Define URL mapping and redirect requirements; flag unmapped high-value pages.
4. Record SEO-critical metadata, canonical behavior, robots rules, sitemaps, structured data, and internal links.
5. Identify analytics, consent, accessibility, performance, and functional checks that need continuity.
6. Define pre-migration backup, staging comparison, cutover approval, monitoring, and rollback criteria.
7. Produce a risk register and go/no-go checklist; do not change DNS or deploy.

## Output
Content inventory, URL mapping template, dependency register, SEO and UX checks, risk matrix, and migration sign-off checklist.

## Safety and limits
- Read-only research and planning only.
- Do not alter DNS, redirects, hosting, or production content.
- Do not promise ranking preservation or zero downtime.
- No runtime activation or tool grants.
